description: Invite a contact-token recipient to a private Space you own, or create a general invitation that needs your approval after someone requests access. Returns invite_url for you to share; no email is sent. A general link is absent from the recipient's invitation inbox until they request access. Previewing the link does not request access. Pending is not membership.

idempotency_key.description: A stable string of 8 to 200 bytes you choose for this write. Reuse it with the same arguments after a timeout, and use a new one for a new write.

name: space_invite_member
title: Invite someone to a private Space
